sections.Profile:
The "Reno" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on September 20, 1957, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1957
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: America, United States, Single Player, Wood Rail, Gambling, Card games, Original Theme
